g_pass: A HIGH MOUNTAIN PASS where the snow field gives way to the rocky Gard mountains: in the west the last patches of old grey-white snow among dark firs; a gravel road with cart ruts climbs east across tough alpine grass and heather; along the whole north side a wall of sheer grey-brown CLIFFS with cracked ledges; along the south side the rock drops away into a deep dark GORGE; a slope strewn with fallen boulders; a tall stone cairn with a rusty iron marker; in the north cliff the boarded-up timber mouth of an old tunnel with a footpath up to it. Palette: slate greys and umbers, dark fir greens, muted alpine greens and heather browns, cold white snow. Cold, windy, rugged.
g_valley: A MINING VALLEY in the Gard mountains, enclosed by high grey-brown cliffs: in the middle of the north cliff the great GATE of an underground mining town, huge timber-and-iron double doors under a carved stone lintel with an anvil emblem, flanked by two tall timber watchtowers; a cold clear mountain stream comes down from the north-east and winds south-west across the valley under timber bridges; grey slag heaps and heaps of ore; an open ore-sorting shed with a slate roof on timber posts; a mine-cart rail track leads from beside the gate east along the valley; gravel roads, alpine grass, heather, firs on the slopes. Palette: slate greys, umbers, iron and timber browns, muted greens, cold blue water. Busy-looking but quiet, a working valley.
g_rail: A MINE-CART LINE ON A CLIFF SHELF high in the Gard mountains: a level shelf cut into the mountainside, bare rock slabs and tough grass, carries a gravel road and a rail track (dark sleepers, steel rails) from the west edge to the east, where the rails run into the timber portal of a tunnel closed by crossed beams; midway a deep side ravine is crossed by a timber TRESTLE bridge (plank deck for the road, the rails beside it); a timber cliff lift with a winch and a hanging iron cage at the south edge of the shelf; below the shelf sheer cliffs fall into a dark chasm; a zigzag footpath climbs the cliff to the grassy ridge top in the north, where a small hermit's hut of fieldstone with a turf roof stands among dwarf pines and heather. Palette: slate greys and umbers, timber browns, muted greens, black depths. Dizzying, windy, lonely.
dovan: A MINING TOWN BUILT INSIDE A HUGE CAVERN under a mountain, on three terraced tiers of rock separated by sheer rock faces: at the bottom (south) the tunnel from the surface opens onto the upper tier with a paved street, a solid two-storey guild office, a cosy inn and a wide tavern hall of dark timber and stone with slate roofs; a broad flight of stone steps and a tall timber lift tower with a winch wheel climb the rock face to the middle tier, a large paved plaza with an item shop, a miner's house and a long stone assembly hall; a long ramp of stone slabs leads on down the next rock face to the lower tier at the back of the cavern, with the great open-fronted forge of the smiths (tall brick chimney, the red mouth of a furnace inside, anvils and a water trough), a tall carved oath stone on a stepped dais, a great timbered mine mouth in the back wall where a rail track runs out and down to a cart station on the plaza, an underground cistern of dark water, a chasm at the east edge; veins of glowing pale-blue ore crystals in the rock walls; packed-earth floors between the paving. Palette: dark umber rock, warm timber browns, slate greys, iron, touches of pale blue crystal. Warm, crowded, built into the stone.
mine_1: THE FIRST FLOOR OF AN OLD DEEP MINE: galleries of packed earth and grey-brown rock dug through dark stone, shored with heavy timber frames; a rail track for mine carts runs from the entrance in the south up the main gallery to a junction chamber and on east to a cart station at the edge of a deep vertical shaft, crossed only by a narrow rail trestle; a long drift west ends at a cave-in of fallen rock and splintered props; a small crevice nook; an ore-sorting room in the north with heaps of ore; beyond the shaft a gallery climbs north to the stairs down, and a long sloping gallery runs back south-west to the entrance hall. Heavy timber frames shore every gallery mouth; veins of glowing pale-blue ore crystals grow out of the rock here and there; old carts, tool racks and stacked rails lie against the walls; the floors are well-trodden, lighter earth with cart ruts and footprints. Palette: umber and grey-brown rock, timber browns, iron rails, black depths. Dusty, close, old.
mine_2: THE SECOND FLOOR OF AN OLD DEEP MINE, deeper and damper: from the stairs in the north-east a gallery leads to a crossroads chamber; to the west a flooded drift, dark still water on both sides of a timber plank walkway, ending in a small dry chamber; to the south the old miners' rest place, a wider chamber with a long rough bench against the rock, a wooden shift board on a timber prop and a trickle of water into a little pool; to the east a side tunnel winding to a small chamber; to the south-west a gallery down to the stairs chamber. Heavy timber frames shore the walls at every gallery mouth; veins of glowing pale-blue ore crystals grow out of the rock here and there; old broken carts, tool racks and stacked rails lie against the walls; the floors are well-trodden, lighter earth with cart ruts, footprints and puddles. Palette: umber and grey rock, dark teal water, timber browns. Damp, echoing, lonely.
mine_3: THE SEVENTH LAYER, the deepest floor of an ancient mine: from the stairs in the north-west a winding gallery of old worn rock with small side niches descends to a square antechamber paved with worn slabs; in its north wall stands a colossal sealed ROCK DOOR of two carved stone slabs (an anvil and a hammer, iron bands); behind it a great rounded hall of ancient dressed stone where a giant armoured guardian of dark riveted iron sits on a throne-dais with a hammer across its knees, and behind the guardian a jagged BREACH in the floor showing only a pale featureless white nothing. The old gallery is shored with timber frames; in the hall veins of glowing pale-blue ore crystal grow out of the ancient stone. The floors are lighter, well-worn stone and earth, clearly lighter than the walls. Palette: dark grey and violet-grey stone, iron, pale white in the breach. Ancient, silent, oppressive.
volk: THE HIDDEN VILLAGE OF THE SMITHS at the bottom of a deep mountain gorge: sheer grey-brown cliffs all round with ferns and moss in the cracks; in the north-east a tall WATERFALL pours into a clear pool, and the stream runs south-west across the gorge floor and out under the south cliff; a sturdy timber inn, a great open-fronted stone smithy with a tall brick chimney and a big wooden water wheel turning in the stream beside it, a few small smith's cottages of fieldstone with slate roofs, a little shrine of the smith-god; a small cobbled work yard with an anvil on a stump; gravel lanes and short alpine grass; an old rope bridge comes in at the south over the dark gorge; steep stone steps climb the north-west cliff. Palette: slate greys, warm timber browns, mossy greens, cold white-blue water, touches of forge red. Secluded, hard-working, homely.
vein_1: THE FIRST FLOOR OF THE ABYSS VEIN, deep below an ancient mine: raw galleries through dark violet-grey rock streaked everywhere with VEINS OF GLOWING PALE-BLUE CRYSTAL; from the stairs in the north-west a gallery winds down to a big crystal cavern; east of it an old cart station stands on the rim of a wide dark chasm (a faint crystal glow far below), crossed only by a narrow rail trestle; beyond the chasm galleries lead north to a small grotto and south to the stairs down. A few old timber frames. Palette: deep violet-grey and blue-grey rock, glowing cyan-white crystal, old timber browns, black depths. Wondrous, silent, untouched.
vein_2: THE SECOND FLOOR OF THE ABYSS VEIN: a great cavern whose middle is a still, dark UNDERGROUND LAKE reflecting glowing crystals, crossed by old timber plank walkways on posts that meet on a small islet crowned by a tall cluster of glowing crystal; to the west a low grotto glittering with countless small crystals (the nest of the gem hedgehogs); galleries lead south to a quiet nook and south-west to the stairs down. Crystal veins glow in the rock everywhere. Palette: deep violet-grey rock, black-teal water, glowing cyan-white crystal, old timber browns. Hushed, sparkling, eerie.
vein_3: THE HEART OF THE ABYSS VEIN, the deepest place: from the stairs in the south a short gallery opens into a great round hall of dark smooth rock; out of its north wall bulges one immense ragged mass of huge glowing pale-blue and violet crystals of many sizes (an irregular organic outline, never a straight band); four tall crystal pillars stand in the hall; the floor is scattered with crystal shards and glittering dust, cracks glowing faintly; a small treasure niche opens in the north-east. Palette: very dark violet-grey rock, brilliant cyan-white and violet crystal. Awe-inspiring, humming with power.
